nonprofit_organization: Whether the employer is described in the relevant 501(a), 501(c)(3), 521, or 401(a) provisions; do not infer legal status from industry alone.
nonprofit_coverage_waiver: Actual or deemed pre-1984 waiver certificate, its effective coverage period and termination history.
nonprofit_employee_concurrence: Whether an existing employee is covered by required concurrence or is a later hire under a pre-1984 waiver.
place_of_work: Whether services occurred within the United States or abroad; distinct from residence.
